decision.hypothesis: Holding east now should clear the farmhouse and shrubs and reach the bus stop route toward Pelican Town.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. Use the clear mailbox-level path east through the bus stop, then turn south in Pelican Town instead of continuing to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
